{InvalidPath}: Invalid path. Do not fail me again.
{InvalidSaveFolder}: This is not the X3 save folder. The save folder ends with 'save'.
{Tips.BtnGenerateSystems}: Generates a new map with sectors and gate connections based on selected settings.
{Tips.BtnX3Root}: Click to set the root folder of your Mayhem installation.
{Tips.BtnX3Save}: Click to set the location where your X3 saved game files are stored.
{Tips.SectorCount}: Double-click a void to add a sector, or right-click a cell to add or remove one. Allowed: {0}–{1}.
{Map.Valid}: VALID: Unknown Enclave present; all sectors connected.
{Tips.VoidSlider}: Target percentage of empty cells. The sector count stays within the selected galaxy size limits.
{Tips.CbClusteredVoids}: Attempts to group the empty (void) areas together rather than sprinkle empty sectors randomly.
{Tips.CbClusteredXenon}: Attempts to group Xenon sectors together rather than sprinkle empty sectors randomly.
{Tips.CbLimitedEnclaves}: When unchecked, the gate generator will attempt to remove some gates where doing so will result in a sector having only 1 gate in or out.
{Tips.CbSaboteurMode}: -20% sector stats. In Expanded, this is compensated by increasing production speed by 40% (overall 12% faster than average) and +1 additional perk slot.
{Tips.SlFog}: Sets average fog level across the galaxy.
{Tips.GbExpansion}: Determines ratio of unknown sectors to populated sectors for a map. Higher expansion results in fewer unknown sectors at game start.
{Tips.GbSystemSpread}: Provides a race specific offset (weight) that will reduce or increase the starting number of sectors of that race relative to the other races.
{Tips.GbGalaxySize}: Choose the galaxy size. Small allows 50–85 sectors, medium 86–144, and large 145–246.
{Tips.GbGateDensity}: Determines the level of gates created near a race's borders. Low density results in fewer gates connecting differing races.
{Tips.GbMusic}:
Determines the music list used for sector music.
Basic: Music files listed in \mayhem_data\custom_musics.txt
Litcube: Music files listed in \mayhem_data\custom_musics_lu.txt
All: All music files found in your \soundtrack folder
Custom: Music files from your selected music folder
{Tips.GbRelations}: Allows you to set permanent friend/foe status between races at game start.
{Tips.cbChaotic}: Xenon own half of the map. Their Maelstrom sector is in the corner unless the game is on Insane difficulty.
{Tips.cbPeaceful}: Only a single Xenon sector is created. This is also the Maelstrom sector.
{Tips.btnShowSectorStats}: Show population and station support on the galaxy map.
{Tips.btnShowSectorNames}: Show sector names on the galaxy map.
{Tips.btnLaunchWeaponsEditor}: Open the Ships and Weapons editor to randomize ship and weapon stats.
{Tips.btnConfig}: Edit Mayhem game settings in the 9972 and 9973 t-files.
{Tips.edit9972}: Edit Mayhem settings in the 9972 t-file.
{Tips.edit9973}: Edit Zero Hour and Renegades settings in the 9973 t-file.
{Tips.txtFindSector}: Find sectors by name or partial name. Press Enter for the next match or Shift+Enter for the previous match.
{Tips.btnFindNext}: Go to the next matching sector.
{Tips.btnExportPng}: Save the complete galaxy map as a PNG image.
